answer: Treat each seat bond as an insurance deductible and charge a per-epoch premium set by an actuarial model that measures behavioral correlation. Fund, time, or answer like your neighbors and the model reads you as one risk pool: a cluster whose moves echo each other has every member premium raised together, superlinearly. So a 500-identity farm finds no haven in numbers, its correlated seats bleeding capital like a river in flood, while a genuinely independent agent keeps paying the flat base rate. On any detected fraud the whole pool of deductibles is slashed as one.
